PolyKV is a system that allows multiple concurrent inference agents to share a single, asymmetrically compressed key-value cache pool, achieving a stable 2.91x compression ratio across different model scales, context lengths, and agent counts.

This research proposes a method called "Global Retention-Based KV Eviction" that learns and applies selective, learnable eviction policies for key-value (KV) cache in long-context inference tasks, aiming to improve performance without sacrificing full-cache inference.
